commit_date: 2026-10 (HEAD develop pinné via `git ls-remote https://github.com/Kareadita/Kavita HEAD` ; dernier tag stable v0.9.1.4 — HEAD choisi, runtime rapporte 0.9.1.11)
framework: .NET 10 (global.json sdk 10.0.0 — la spec disait « .NET 8 », c'est .NET 10 en réalité) + Angular 22 (kavita-webui@0.7.12.1, @angular/* ^22.1.3) + EF Core/SQLite — première stack .NET/Angular de la boucle
served_source: Build local obligatoire : l'image docker officielle (kazaoki/kavita, jvmilazz0/kavita) sert un bundle prédéfini impossible à patcher — écart image/SHA documenté : pas d'image pour le SHA pinné. Backend compilé `dotnet build -c Release` (Kavita.Server/bin/Release/net10.0), frontend `npm run prod` (UI/Web/dist/browser). POINT CRITIQUE : Kavita.Server sert wwwroot depuis le CWD (FallbackController : Path.Combine(GetCurrentDirectory(),'wwwroot')) — déployer dist/browser dans <rundir>/wwwroot, PAS dans bin/

boot.deps: dotnet SDK 10.0.401 (dotnet-install.sh, ~/work/dotnet10 — DOIT exporter DOTNET_ROOT=$HOME/work/dotnet10 + PATH, l'apphost ne le trouve pas sinon) + node via nvm (outillage audit)
boot.clone: git clone https://github.com/Kareadita/Kavita ~/work/kavita45 && git -C ~/work/kavita45 checkout f75863cb77c0f6aa26e0794a1848294e63c9d07d
boot.build-backend: cd ~/work/kavita45 && DOTNET_ROOT=$HOME/work/dotnet10 PATH=$HOME/work/dotnet10:$PATH dotnet build -c Release  # ~40s, 0 error
boot.build-frontend: cd ~/work/kavita45/UI/Web && export NVM_DIR=$HOME/.nvm && source $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh && npm install --no-audit --no-fund (npm ci échoue amont — lock désynchronisé ; documenté, package-lock.json EXCLU du patch) && npm run prod  # -> dist/browser
boot.run: mkdir -p ~/work/kv45-run/config && cp -r ~/work/kavita45/UI/Web/dist/browser ~/work/kv45-run/wwwroot && printf '{"TokenKey":"<cle-64b>","Port":7500,"IpAddresses":"","BaseUrl":"/","Cache":75}' > ~/work/kv45-run/config/appsettings.json && cp -r ~/work/kavita45/Kavita.Server/bin/Release/net10.0/* ~/work/kv45-run/ && cd ~/work/kv45-run && DOTNET_ROOT=$HOME/work/dotnet10 PATH=$HOME/work/dotnet10:$PATH nohup ./Kavita.Server > kv.log 2>&1 & # prêt quand http://localhost:7500/login -> 200 (~15-20s ; le port SANS appsettings.json est 5000 par défaut)
boot.admin_seed: python3 tools/seed.py http://localhost:7500 ~/work/kv45-media  # rejouable : medias CBZ/EPUB généres, admin kv45admin, 3 libs (Manga/Comics/Books) enableMetadata=1, scan-all, 7 series, reading list, collection, invite alice.kv45@localhost
boot.creds: admin kv45admin / Kv45-Admin!Pass (config/appsettings.json TokenKey + seed) — login.mjs récupère le JWT dans localStorage['kavita-user'] -> auth.json

audit.baseline: node audit.mjs --urls "$(paste -sd, urls-public.txt)" --out ../reports/baseline-public --states none --wait-for 'app-root' --wait 2000 http://localhost:7500 && node audit.mjs --urls "$(paste -sd, urls-auth.txt)" --out ../reports/baseline-auth --states none --storage-state auth.json --wait-for 'app-root' --wait 2000 http://localhost:7500 && node audit.mjs --urls "/home" --out ../reports/baseline-states --states all --storage-state auth.json --wait-for 'app-root' --wait 2000 http://localhost:7500
audit.final: mêmes commandes avec --out ../reports/final-{public,auth,states} — exécutées après dernier rebuild+deploy
audit.install_build: clone vierge ~/work/kavita45-virgin + git apply patch.diff (44 fichiers, --check OK) + npm install && npm run prod + dotnet build -c Release + run dir ~/work/kv45-virgin-run + seed rejoué (7 series) + rescan reports/installbuild-{public,auth} : 0 viol
audit.verify: node verify.mjs http://localhost:7500 -> 34/34 PASS ; node eval-final.mjs http://localhost:7500 -> 35/35 PASS ; incomplete-probes sur report scan5-auth + scan7-states -> 0 FAIL (112+88 N-A, 200+50 PASS, 1 link-in-text-block N-A + 1 aria-hidden-focus N-A)

patch.exclu: UI/Web/package-lock.json (modifie par npm install amont, pas un fix a11y)
patch.domaines:
aria-allowed-role (html), page-has-heading-one (h1 dans main), landmark-one-main/region (main + nav role=navigation labels), button-name (card-actionables [attr.aria-label] 'Actions for {{name}}', icones, toggles), list (navbar), link-name (brand/donate), aria-required-children/parent/listitem (ngbNav li role=presentation, typeahead), color-contrast (muted->body-text, btn-primary/nav-pill texte noir sur vert, badge/toast), heading-order (h4/h5/h6->h2/h3), aria-dialog-name (modal ariaLabelledBy), duplicate-id ([attr.id], entity-id retire) ; fixer-v2 : +aria-dialog-name actionable-modal (id+ariaLabelledBy), stats/profile tab — aria-prohibited-attr (legend-cell role=img), scrollable-region-focusable (graph-wrapper tabindex), color-contrast stats (--activity-graph-text-color/--text-muted→body-text), heading-order stats (titres/sous-titres cartes→
